variants.name: NAR
variants.blurb: A non-autoregressive model encodes text + image and a shared scorer scores all candidates in a single forward pass.

variants.name: AR LL
variants.blurb: The same MedGemma backbone emits exactly one token — the fastest of the autoregressive paths.

variants.name: MedJev
variants.blurb: A compact causal LM that scores the candidate set directly — no answer tokens are written.

variants.name: AR Head
variants.blurb: A frozen MedGemma backbone feeds a small trained pointer head that scores every option at once.

variants.name: AR Gen
variants.blurb: MedGemma writes free text up to 32 tokens, one at a time, then the text is parsed into a choice.

note: Each snake makes one move per decision. A decision costs the variant's measured mean latency, so faster variants outrun slower ones. On-screen speed is rescaled into a readable range; the measured ms values are the real numbers.
